questions.question: NDE partners ask for a feature that increases fabric risk. Best SDM response:
options: Clarify customer need, propose safer alternatives, and disagree/commit with data—not silent assent
Build exactly as asked with no pushback

questions.question: When platform debt and NDE feature asks collide, prioritize by:
options: Impact on customer/fabric risk and long-term delivery capacity—with transparent tradeoffs

questions.question: Stakeholder status for Network Core should include:
options: R/Y/G, risks, asks, and customer/fabric impact—not activity theater

questions.question: Complex idea to non-network stakeholders:
options: Analogy + impact + decision needed — then offer deep dive

questions.question: Working with service teams on network dependencies:
options: Identify deliverables early; track; communicate slips
questions.explanation: JD: ensure network dependencies identified and delivered.

questions.question: Conflict between customer ask and safety bar:
options: Explain trade-offs; seek safer path that still meets need

questions.question: Synergies with other engineering teams:
options: Share best practices, reuse tooling, create growth opportunities
questions.explanation: JD: improve synergies and opportunities for engineers.

questions.question: Roadmap communication fails when:
options: Priorities are unclear and owners missing
questions.explanation: JD: develop and maintain project road maps.

questions.question: Written escalation to directors should include:
Customer unique requirements (per JD) require:
options: Careful scoping, security/compliance checks, and clear delivery plans
questions.explanation: JD: serving large customers with unique requirements.

questions.question: Compliance/security engagement is:
options: Required — adopt AWS best practices and policies
Only for auditors once a year
questions.explanation: JD: compliance with policies and security.

questions.question: AGSVA clearance note for AU roles means:
options: Be prepared for government vetting eligibility as a job requirement
It is only for contractors abroad
questions.explanation: JD requires ability to attain AGSVA clearance.
